entities.summary: Witalis Ludwiczak was a Polish lawyer specializing in civil law and private international law; professor ordinarius of Adam Mickiewicz University; a rower; and an ice hockey player who competed in 1932 and 1936 Winter Olympics. He was the first Olympian from Poznań.
